text.description_html:
Hagar HTBB1279454526D 4-1/2 x 4-1/2 Hospital Tip Door Hinge with 2 Ball Bearings

Special Hospital Tip door hinge. Used in detention centers (prisons ...) and hospitals. The special design of the hinge tip deters self hangings. Medium duty door hinge, standard .134" thickness with 2 ball bearings.

Specifications:

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.134"
  • 2 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Hospital Tip
  • US26D Brushed Chrome Finish
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • NRP Steel Hinge Pin
  • Conforms to ANSI A8112 for Ball Bearing

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually

*This item is on back order. Please use Bommer 4-1/2 Hospital Tip Door Hinge
